market_mood: Risk-on relief rally after the Democrats' decisive midterm win removed political uncertainty, with oil sharply lower. Underneath, AI/semiconductor stocks are weak and rate-hike worries persist.

themes.title: Democrats sweep the midterms; relief rally
themes.what_happened: The S&P 500 rose 1.6% to 7,688.62 and the Dow rose 3% to 53,356.12. The VIX fell about 20% to 16.61. Trump said he accepted the results and would work with Democrats.
themes.why_it_matters: Investors are betting a divided government limits sweeping legislation, fiscal expansion and inflationary pressure.

our_exposure.why: Amazon rose 6.1% as AI heavyweights outperformed.
Broad rally helps; banking-regulation outlook under Democrats flagged as uncertain.

themes.next: Whether Trump's conciliatory tone lasts, since the focus shifts to whether his latest move has staying power. Also watch Democratic-led policy on health care, banking and AI.

themes.title: Oil collapses on Iran-war de-escalation hopes
themes.what_happened: WTI closed down 8.3% at about $88.12, oil's biggest daily decline since April. Brent traded as high as $118 on Friday and was near $94 by Wednesday. VP Vance said the GOP lost because of the war.
themes.why_it_matters: The war pushed gasoline and diesel prices sharply higher and worsened stubborn inflation, so lower oil eases pressure on consumers and rates.

our_exposure.why: Cheaper fuel eases pressure on its consumer base and costs.
Lower energy prices ease input costs and consumer budgets.
Less inflation pressure on household spending and rate expectations.
Lower fuel prices cut ticket values but free up consumer spending.
Lower fuel prices cut ticket values but free up consumer spending.

themes.next: A senior Iranian official said Iran and the US remain far from a deal, so the move could reverse. Watch Qatar-mediated talks and any renewed strikes.

themes.title: Hawkish Fed hold; hike odds and 10-year near 5%
themes.what_happened: On Nov 3 the 10-year yield rose to 4.954% and CME odds of a December Fed hike rose to 79% from 74%. The 10-year was at 4.906% on Monday. Treasuries rallied after the Fed held. Energy prices are flagged as the key risk because they could feed into core inflation.
themes.why_it_matters: A policy rate that may rise instead of fall, with the 10-year near 5%, pressures valuations and rate-sensitive sectors. The oil drop may ease that pressure.

our_exposure.why: Housing-linked demand and valuation are sensitive to high yields.
Higher rates help margins but raise credit and valuation risk.
Higher rates help margins but raise credit and valuation risk.
Large long-duration growth weight (17%) is sensitive to higher discount rates.

themes.next: This week's labour data will decide whether yields stay below 5% or return toward recent highs. Also watch oil's pass-through to inflation and Fed commentary.

themes.title: AI trade splits: data-center and chip selloff; Apple falls on guidance
themes.what_happened: Data center operators slumped (Hut 8 -23%) and the Philadelphia semiconductor index hit a six-month low, down 3.1%. Some large tech stocks rose on expectations that a slower AI buildout favors them. Apple beat on revenue and EPS but fell 4.5% after hours on weaker guidance.
themes.why_it_matters: AI capex worries and regulation fears are driving dispersion inside tech. Free cash flow turning negative and more capex planned for 2027 gave investors indigestion.

our_exposure.why: Margins pressured by memory chip costs and slower services growth forecast.
Rose 6.1% Wednesday as AI heavyweights beat data-center plays.

themes.next: CoreWeave reports after the bell next Tuesday (Nov 10), with short interest elevated. This is a read on AI infrastructure demand.
